name: Villainess x Reborn
source:
You’ve died…and yet?

After falling victim to a speeding truck while playing an old otome game you once loved, you find yourself cast in the role of the one and only villainess. 

It’s hard enough trying to navigate old, twisted relationships and new, blossoming ones — but with the original heroine on the loose and the pressing mystery behind why you’re always fated to die at the year’s end, you have a tough road ahead of you to navigate. 

There’s no one who can save you but yourself, after all.

[From [url=https://eigenstuffs.itch.io/villainess-x-reborn]Itch.io[/url]]
